description: This is a C# source file defining the CatalogItem class, which represents an item in a product catalog within an e-commerce application. It includes properties for item details and methods to update its state, implementing domain logic and validation.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Represents a catalog product item with properties such as name, description, price, and related brand and type information. Contains methods to update its details, brand, type, and picture URI.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new catalog item with provided details.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's name, description, and price with validation.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog brand ID, with validation for non-zero value.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog type ID, with validation for non-zero value.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Sets a new picture URI based on the provided filename or clears it if empty.
